ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Lines AB and CD intersect at point O, and OE bisects $\angle BOD$. As shown in Figure 1, if $\angle BOC=130^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle AOE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle BOC= 130^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOD=\angle BOC=130^\circ$,\\
$\angle BOD=180^\circ-\angle BOC=50^\circ$.\\
Since OE bisects $\angle BOD$,\\
it follows that $\angle DOE=25^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle AOE=\angle AOD+\angle DOE=\boxed{155^\circ}$.
